decision: Body = FE1 Si sedan, base scan 'civic Facelift FE1 Full Car.stl' (1RIThsxwQgD_KB-58-JiL0y6x1HycU8LZ), not the suggested FL2 Full Car
why: Looked at both (ortho + Blender): FE1 has complete wheels and a clean roof; FL2 has a broken rear wheel and a roof hole. The state scans named in the brief (Door Open, Trunk Open, Trunk Open no trim) are FE1 sedan states registered to this car (30-37% of each within 6 mm of the full car, rest = the moved panel)

decision: FL2-folder 'civic Trunk Open' (Feb 2026) is the same sedan trunk scan as FE1 'civic Trunk Open' (identical distance stats); 2024 'Civic Si Si rear end/trunk open' and the FL5 Type R scans not used
why: 2024 Si scans are in another frame (1% within 6 mm of the car); one body only per brief

decision: Hood and rear-glass holes filled: PreFacelift FE1 scan (same car before its bumper swap) ICP'd on the upper body (0.21 deg, 4 mm; then 1.5 mm median) adds gap triangles; remaining speckled holes replaced by a robust quadratic panel fit (0.4-0.5 mm residual on the surrounding paint) - tools/patch_holes.py, tools/fill_top.py
why: Dark paint dropped out in two see-through patches on the hood and rear glass; the top-down and high 3/4 shots would show the engine bay through the hood. Only those two hand-boxed zones are touched

decision: Removed a flat prop sheet 0.3 m off the floor under the rear-left bumper and up-facing floor scraps under the front axle (tools/deground.py); right-rear wheel is only a tyre ring in every FE1 capture, so hero angles favour the car's left side
why: Seen floating under the car in the rear 3/4 check render; ray-picked to locate; car underside faces down so up-facing slabs are not car

decision: Canonical frame = ive prep of fe1_full_4mm_clean (car4.json: front +Y, car's right +X, floor z=0); every later mesh prepped with --like car4.json
why: Lesson: never re-normalise; all FE1 states share the Artec frame

decision: 'Door Open' scan = right side with both doors open: sill, A/B/C jambs, lower arches and part of the cabin; no door panels. Right doors cut from the full car inside traced door outlines (x>0.45 m, panel-gap polylines, mirror goes with the front door), excluding sill surfaces within 8 mm of the Door Open scan (tools/doors.py)
why: Gives two real body panels for the exploded view with real scanned structure behind them; the state scan is the doors-open body as captured (lesson: state scan as captured over the trimmed full car)

decision: Trunk lid = 'civic Trunk Open' lid (outer + trim, goose-necks); closed pose by hinge fit about X (94 deg) then trimmed 6-DOF ICP of the lid skin onto the deck: skin p50 1.8 mm, 80% < 5 mm; animated as a screw rotation about pivot (0, -1.564, 1.330) m prepped, Blender euler (94.08, 0.71, -2.39) + 19 mm slide (tools/trunk.py, hinge_refine.py, lid_clean.py, trunk_base.py)
why: Verified by red-lid-over-car renders: X-only fit left the spoiler tips and a hinge-area sliver sticking out; ICP found a 68 mm lateral offset; body bits within 10 mm of the car were removed from the lid

decision: Close-ups use 2 mm crops of the front-left and rear-left corners (fl2/rl2.blend); full-car moves use the cleaned 4 mm car
why: Style guide: <=2 mm for close-ups; left side because the right-rear wheel is only a tyre ring

decision: Logo = illumaesthetic.com CDN header logo (IllumaestheticLogo_V2COMPLETE_1.png, 6135x1059, browser UA) saved at 2400 px as remotion/public/illumaesthetic_logo.png
why: Gitignored file was missing in this container; brief says to take it from the website

decision: Shot plan (Temerario order): s1 low front-left 3/4 turntable 8 beats, s2 rear-left 3/4 orbit 7, s3 front-left wheel close-up 4, s4 headlight 4, s5 trunk opens on its hinge 7, s6 rise to top-down 6, s7 exploded view (right doors + trunk lid lift up, drift, lock) 16, logo; no text
why: Brief order: turntables -> extreme close-ups -> panels open -> top-down -> exploded -> logo. Beat counts are a 100 BPM placeholder until the generated track arrives; renders carry a 0.2 s tail and get retimed to its accents

decision: Framing after two 30% preview rounds: s1/s2 orbit centres shifted toward the nose/tail so the first frame shows the whole end; s4 at 45 mm and kept left of the 2 mm crop seam; exploded view moved to a high rear-right camera (doors slide to frame-right, lid lifts up) after the side view put the car small and the open-door scan's door edges hung below the sill
why: Contact-sheet review: nose/tail clipped on frame 1, crop seam visible on the hood, side-on explode left the car at ~45 % width and showed open-door fragments (now filtered to x<0.92 m)

decision: Finals s1-s6 queued at a 0.65 s placeholder beat (slightly long) before the music arrived; s7 exploded view waits for the track
why: Brief: do renders while waiting; longer renders can be trimmed to any faster grid, while the explode's separate/lock keys must sit on the real accents

decision: Music = parent session's generated track honda-civic-11_track.mp3 (40.05 s, audio ends 39.8 s). Kick grid (40-120 Hz peaks, tools/kicks.py): t = 0.2899 + 0.41794 k (143.56 BPM); quiet intro to 13.2 s, drop k31 = 13.246 s, half-time kicks at bar steps 0/3/5, breakdown k53-71, big kicks k80 33.725 / k88 37.068
why: Lesson: anchor on the kick peak, not spectral onsets; ive beats agreed on 143.6 BPM and the first strong onset at 7.43 s

decision: Cuts: s1 0-7.395 (k17 first hit) | s2 -13.246 (drop) | s3 wheel -15.336 (k36) | s4 lamp -17.843 (k42) | s5 trunk -22.023 (k52; lid starts on the k44 kick) | s6 top -26.202 (k62) | s7 explode -37.068 (separate on k62, lock on the k80 kick) | logo 37.068-39.8
why: Slow turntables fill the quiet 13 s intro (Temerario pace), close-ups land on the drop's kicks, the exploded view drifts through the breakdown and slams home on the first big kick after it, logo on the last big kick; video ends where the audio ends

decision: Placeholder-grid renders discarded and all shots re-queued with exact durations
why: s1/s2/s6 at the 100 BPM placeholder were 2 s too short for the intro/grid; stretching s1 by 37 % would interpolate from ~11 fps

decision: s7_explode frames 91-166 re-rendered as stills
why: the 166-frame animation run went black from frame 91 (car an unlit silhouette, mean luma 45 -> 5.5); the same frames re-rendered alone are lit, so it was a transient Cycles persistent-data glitch, not the scene

decision: v2 order from the scene-director (direction.md/director.md): N1 whole car front-left -> s3 wheel -> s4 lamp -> N2 right doors out -> N3 trunk opens + lid lifts off -> N4 reassembly + fade -> small logo
why: user v2 notes relayed by the parent session: order by this car's scan features, travel front->side->rear, one continuous sequence per section, no wide all-at-once explode, whole car in the opener, fade then small logo; s1/s2/s5/s6/s7 dropped (clipped nose, repeated rear/top views, legible plate, wide explode)

decision: first cut moved from k17 to k24; intro: N1 0-k24, s3 k24-k28, s4 k28-k31
why: decoded-audio check: k17 rises only +2.9 dB (no hit); k24 +16.6, k28 +17.2, k31 +20.1 dB are the first real accents

decision: rear plate flattened on the lid and the full car (tools/deplate.py), meshes lid_dp / car4f_dp prepped --like car4.json with the original --drop-islands
why: the director found the plate legible in s2/s5/s6/s7 (lessons: deplate every rear shot); face counts match the originals (335523 / 3482773)

decision: N2 doors lift up + slightly out (+1.0 m z) instead of out toward the lens; front-right 3/4 push-in on the openings
why: 30 % preview: doors moving toward the camera covered the jambs; a doors-off still shows real Door Open data worth seeing (sill, A/B/C jambs, seats, steering wheel, far-side door trims) and the black above the car in 9:16 is clear background

decision: dropped an 849-tri scrap hanging below the right sill (tools/boxdrop.py) from doors_base / explode_base / trunk_base
why: it floated under the doors in the N2 preview; the full car had already lost it to --drop-islands 3000 (same face count)

decision: N3 framing: car low in frame, lid lift reduced to 0.55 m, camera pulls back while the lid rises then dives into the interior
why: preview: car sat high with dead black below and the lifted lid left the top of frame (note A cropping)

decision: renders now use projects/honda-civic-11/tools/shot.py (copy of the ferrari renderer) with persistent data off
why: v1 s7 lost its studio lights from frame 91 with persistent data on (luma 45 -> 5.5); standing rule 2026-11-11

decision: logo card remade at 330 px wide (31 % of frame), was 860 px
why: user v2 note 7: fade, then a SMALL logo (Temerario ending)

decision: N1 and N4b (static car, camera-only moves) rendered with persistent data on; N2/N3/N4 (moving parts) off
